measurements.caveat: Vertebral-body compression/deformity screen, NOT a general fracture detector (no power on non-compression fractures: odontoid/facet/posterior arch). Per-vertebra SD wide (~0.13) -> reliable at the group/screening level, coarse per body. Norm is triangulated (no like-for-like healthy cervical MRI Ha/Hp comparator) -> plausibility, not proof. Finding flagged for physician review; clinical correlation required.
